entries.name: Scrape Atlas
entries.summary: Retrieve public profiles, posts, videos and conversations for research through Scrape Atlas’s hosted MCP. Requires a Scrape Atlas account and a compatible MCP client; use the publisher’s documented OAuth or customer-key setup. Successful retrievals, including partial results, consume account credits; paid access uses one-time credit top-ups. Follow source-platform terms and data-use permissions.
